messages:
alex: quick async — what I did / blockers / today

alex: did: validated the kv-cache eviction rollout in eu-west, watched p90 drop ~120ms after warmup. pushed a small metric tweak to exporter (promremap). :white_check_mark:
alex: blocker: one pod in prod still showing sporadic OOMs when sequence len spikes, need a reproducible trace.
alex: today: dig into heap dump, add a fail-safe memory limiter on the batcher, and coordinate canary rollback plan if needed.

mira: thanks — saw the p90 drop too, nice work. where did you push the promremap? link?
mira: also can you add a temporary alert for batcher mem > 75% to avoid noisy pagers?

sam: ops-bot reported a 504 storm at 03:12 UTC earlier (related autoscaler heatup), I muted the route briefly and scaled dedicated pool by +2 GPUs. cc @alex in case related to your evict rollout.

ops-bot: Incident detected: 504 spikes on /v1/generate between 03:12-03:18 UTC. Autoscaler increased pods from 6 -> 8. No errors persisted after scaling. (link to incident: https://internal.incidents/4987) :rotating_light:

alex: sam — yes that autoscaler bump is the same time window. I suspect cold kv-warmup plus larger input sequences triggered backlog -> timeouts. adding mem limiter will help but also planning a small warmup seed change to pre-populate heavy prefixes.

jen: re: alert — +1 to temporary alert, but make it low-urgency (pager: oncall-critical only). We had a noisy alert yesterday.
jen: also FYI i'm merging a tiny change to runbook doc: /runbooks/kvcache-eviction.md to note workaround and rollback steps.

mira: proposed alert rule: batcher_memory_ratio > 0.75 for 3m -> severity: warning (no page); >0.85 for 1m -> severity: critical (page oncall). I'll open a PR in monitoring repo.

sam: quick check — can someone review my autoscaler tweak PR? small change to cooldowns: 60s -> 90s. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

alex: I'll review in a bit, expect comments. If reviewers are slow, we should at least fast-follow the canary rollback playbook.

mira: blocker for me: need an owner to validate the HSM key rotation test in staging; can't proceed with Private rollout without it. @jen can you or @sam take a look later today?

jen: I can validate after 10:30am PT. will run the key rotation scenario and post results here.

alex: action items recap:
- alex: investigate OOM trace + implement memory limiter on batcher (today)
- mira: open monitoring PR for batcher memory alert (this morning)
- sam: follow up on autoscaler cooldown PR and coordinate with alex if rollback needed
- jen: run HSM rotation test in staging at ~10:30am PT and report

alex: ping me here with any pages related to kv or batcher, i'll be on-call-lite until 5pm PT. thanks all :thumbsup:
